title: First-Line Supervisors of Production and Operating Workers
description: Directly supervise and coordinate the activities of production and operating workers, such as inspectors, precision workers, machine setters and operators, assemblers, fabricators, and plant and system operators. Excludes team or work leaders.

tasks.text: Enforce safety and sanitation regulations.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Enforcing rules requires human presence and authority

dwas.name: Enforce rules or regulations.

tasks.text: Keep records of employees' attendance and hours worked.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record production data into structured logs

dwas.name: Record operational or production data.

tasks.text: Inspect materials, products, or equipment to detect defects or malfunctions.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical inspection of production machinery in situ

dwas.name: Inspect production equipment.

tasks.text: Read and analyze charts, work orders, production schedules, and other records and reports to determine production requirements and to evaluate current production estimates and outputs.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Blueprint setup reading partial, human confirms

dwas.name: Study blueprints or other instructions to determine equipment setup requirements.

tasks.text: Plan and establish work schedules, assignments, and production sequences to meet production goals.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Sequence planning aided; production constraints human-verified

dwas.name: Plan production or operational procedures or sequences.

tasks.text: Confer with other supervisors to coordinate operations and activities within or between departments.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Colleague information exchange is relational, contextual

dwas.name: Exchange information with colleagues.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Interpret specifications, blueprints, job orders, and company policies and procedures for workers.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Equipment instruction requires live demonstration and correction

dwas.name: Instruct workers to use equipment or perform technical procedures.

tasks.text: Observe work and monitor gauges, dials, and other indicators to ensure that operators conform to production or processing standards.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Sensor/vision monitoring possible, but physical verification and accountability remain human

dwas.name: Monitor equipment operation to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Direct and coordinate the activities of employees engaged in the production or processing of goods, such as inspectors, machine setters, or fabricators.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Directing production operations is human supervisory authority

dwas.name: Direct operational or production activities.

tasks.text: Conduct employee training in equipment operations or work and safety procedures, or assign employee training to experienced workers.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Equipment instruction requires live demonstration and correction

dwas.name: Instruct workers to use equipment or perform technical procedures.

tasks.text: Evaluate employee performance.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Performance review aided; accountability and context human

dwas.name: Evaluate employee performance.
dwas.gwa_name: Judging the Qualities of Objects, Services, or People

tasks.text: Confer with management or subordinates to resolve worker problems, complaints, or grievances.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Diagnosis support good; physical resolution needs humans

dwas.name: Confer with others to resolve production problems or equipment malfunctions.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Determine standards, budgets, production goals, and rates, based on company policies, equipment and labor availability, and workloads.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Sequence planning aided; production constraints human-verified

dwas.name: Plan production or operational procedures or sequences.

tasks.text: Calculate labor and equipment requirements and production specifications, using standard formulas.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Production requirement calc; human validates inputs

dwas.name: Calculate specific material, equipment, or labor requirements for production.

tasks.text: Recommend or implement measures to motivate employees and to improve production methods, equipment performance, product quality, or efficiency.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Generates improvement options; human tailors and owns

dwas.name: Determine metal or plastic production methods.
Advise others on ways to improve processes or products.
